title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the inductance L.

title: Use of Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the formula for inductance L = (N^2 * mu_0 * A) / l.

title: Magnetic Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the magnetic field B using B = mu_0 * n * I correctly.

title: Area Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the cross-sectional area A of the solenoid accurately.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Neglecting Edge Effects
description: Optional Criteria: The student should acknowledge the assumption of neglecting edge effects in the solenoid.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the inductance formula.
